name: Swiss type poster
description: A swiss typographic poster, 1080 by 1350. Three huge stacked lines of type, flush left, the last one sitting on a hairline rule near the bottom; one big accent circle behind the type at the top right; tiny spaced labels above the top rule and below the bottom rule. Strict, confident, cultural.
use: lectures, design weeks, conferences, launches, exhibitions, statements and slogans: three words that carry the whole message
